title: Sandbox escape due to use-after-free in the DOM: Content Processes component
description: This vulnerability is a use-after-free flaw in the DOM Content Processes component of Microsoft software, which can lead to sandbox escape. It affects version 4.0 of the product. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and there is no indication of known exploitation in the wild. No patch or remediation details are available from the vendor at this time.
